title: Do You Want to Be Healed?
summaryZh: 我們必須承認自己的破碎，放棄無效的自我醫治策略，將一切交給唯一的醫治者耶穌。
lines: In John chapter five, Jesus asks a question that at first glance seems puzzling, if not even offensive.
在約翰福音第五章中，耶穌問了一個乍看之下令人不解，甚至有些冒犯的問題。
He comes across a man who has been severely disabled for 38 years, and He asks him, “Do you want to be healed?”
祂遇到一個重度殘疾三十八年的人，祂問他：「你要痊癒嗎？」
Duh, what kind of question is that?
Of course the man wants to be healed.
The answer is obvious, but is it?
答案顯而易見，但真的是這樣嗎？

I've spent years as a pastor and a counselor, and in both of those roles, I found myself in situations where I've been sitting across from somebody else and I've had to ask them, do you really want to be healed?
我當牧師和諮商師已經很多年了，在這兩個角色中，我常發現自己坐在某人對面，而我必須問他們，你真的想痊癒嗎？
But do you know what else?
I've not only asked that question of others, I've asked that question to myself.
我不僅問過別人這個問題，我也問過自己。
Joe, do you really want to be healed, to be changed, to be restored, to be made into the person you were created to be?
喬，你真的想痊癒、被改變、被恢復，成為你受造時該有的樣子嗎？
To put a fine point on this, I think many of us are actually afraid of healing, because healing means letting Jesus, even letting others into deep, dark, painful, ugly places.
說白了，我認為我們很多人其實害怕得醫治，因為得醫治意味著讓耶穌，甚至讓別人進入我們內心深處那黑暗、痛苦、醜陋的地方。
To put a fine point on this
Healing means a completely new way of living in the fullness of what God has for us.
得醫治意味著一種全新的生活方式，活在神為我們預備的豐盛中。
And maybe, just maybe, if we're being honest, that new way of living sounds like more than we're ready for.
也許，只要我們誠實面對自己，那種新的生活方式聽起來是我們還沒準備好要承受的。
Like this man in John five, there are two things we have to accept, and these things are not exactly easy to accept.
就像約翰福音第五章裡的這個人一樣，有兩件事我們必須接受，而這些事並不那麼容易接受。
One, we've got to admit that we need healing.
第一，我們必須承認我們需要醫治。
Some of us still won't do that.
我們有些人仍然不願意這麼做。
我最後一定會戒掉這個的。
I just, I just have to try harder.
我只是，我只是需要再努力一點。
Are you willing to admit that there is deep brokenness in you?
你願意承認你裡面有很深的破碎嗎？
Are you willing to admit you're as desperate for healing as this man in John five?
你願意承認你和約翰福音第五章這個人一樣，極度渴望得到醫治嗎？
And two, we have to admit our strategies to heal ourselves don't work.
第二，我們必須承認我們自我醫治的策略是無效的。
This man was trying to get healed by taking a dip in a pool, but that obviously hadn't worked for 38 years.
這人試圖藉由在池子裡泡一下來得醫治，但這在三十八年來顯然沒有奏效。
We too have our own failed healing strategies.
我們也有自己失敗的醫治策略。
When we try to find healing and success and approval and pleasure and a hundred other things that do nothing to bring true and lasting healing.
當我們試圖尋找醫治、成功、認同和享樂，以及其他一百種對帶來真實和持久醫治毫無幫助的事物時。
Jesus is asking us, are we willing to turn from our sad strategies and trust Him instead?
耶穌在問我們，我們是否願意轉離我們可悲的策略，轉而信靠祂？
So do you want to be healed?
If so, bring it all to Jesus and invite Him to do it only He can do.
如果是的話，把這一切都帶到耶穌面前，邀請祂成就只有祂能做的事。
It might look different than you think.
過程可能跟你想的不一樣。
He may want to use people in your life to deliver His care.
祂可能想透過你生命中的人來傳遞祂的關懷。
It might take longer than you think.
這可能需要比你想像更長的時間。
Full and complete healing may not be on this side of heaven, but He is the only healer.
在回天家之前，可能無法得到完全徹底的醫治，但祂是唯一的醫治者。
